_comment: Extension IDs papers-native-host may accept. 'development' is the pinned smoke-test extension in dev-extension/: its Chrome ID is derived from the public key in manifest.chrome.json (the private key was discarded, so the ID cannot be published to a store) and its gecko ID uses the reserved .invalid domain. 'release' holds the store-assigned IDs of the #24 extension (browser-extension/src): empty placeholders until it is published to the Chrome Web Store / AMO; `npm run build:release` refuses to build while they are empty (see browser-extension/README.md). Installers register release IDs; development IDs only on explicit request.
